consequent.text: Benefics in the 7th house of the prasna chart are auspicious for the couple's future.

quote: The presence of benefics in the 7th house is good.

ambiguity_notes: The debilitation/unfriendly-sign qualifier on the malefics is not folded into the placement leaf; only occupancy of the 1st/7th/8th is encoded.

consequent.text: Debilitated or unfriendly-placed malefics in the 1st, 7th and 8th threaten the life of the married couple.

quote:
The married couple will die if malefics are debilitated or are in 
unfriendly signs in the 1st, the 7th and the 8th.

ambiguity_notes: The Arudha-Lagna aspect clause is in the arudha frame, which planet_aspects_house does not reckon; the unfriendly-sign alternative and the Moon parallel are quoted here.

consequent.text: A debilitated (or unfriendly-placed) Sun that aspects neither the ascendant nor the Arudha Lagna: the bride is fatherless; the Moon similarly placed makes her motherless.

quote:
If the Sun is debilitated or occupies an unfriendly sign and does not 
aspect either the ascendant or Arudha Lagna the bride will have no father.

consequent.text: Venus and the lord of the 7th both in Upachayas (3rd, 6th, 10th, 11th): the couple are happy after marriage and beget children.

quote:
If Venus and the lord of the 7th house occupy Upachayas, the couple will 
be happy after marriage and beget children.

ambiguity_notes: The stanza reads 'all the benefics'; the leaf fires on a benefic in each of the 5th and 11th, not necessarily every benefic.

consequent.text: Benefics in the 5th and the 11th houses: the woman is pregnant.

quote:
All the benefics in the 5th and the 11th houses indicate that the woman is 
pregnant.

ambiguity_notes: The lord-of-5th conjunction/aspect and the count-by-strength rider are not encoded; the three benefics' relation to the 5th is.

consequent.text: Venus, Jupiter and Mercury (with the lord of the 5th) conjoining or aspecting the 5th: many children; the number tracks the 5th lord's strength.

quote:
Ancient preceptors aver that many children will be born if Venus, Jupiter 
and Mercury and the lord of the 5th conjoin or aspect the 5th house.

ambiguity_notes: 'Afflicted' also covers malefic aspect on the 5th; only malefic occupancy of the 5th is encoded as the leaf.

consequent.text: The 5th house afflicted by malefics: the woman bears no children, or any born will die.

quote:
If the 5th house is afflicted by malefic planets, the woman will not bear 
any children.

consequent.text: Mars in the 5th in Aries, Leo, Scorpio or Pisces, aspected by Jupiter: birth of children.

quote:
There will be birth of children if Mars occupies the 5th house which must 
be Aries, Leo, Scorpio or Pisces and which must have the benefic aspect of Jupiter.

ambiguity_notes: The 'associates with the lord of the 5th' alternative and the 'unaspected by benefics' qualifier are noted; Rahu-in-5th is the encoded leaf.

consequent.text: Rahu in the 5th (or joined to the 5th lord) without benefic aspect: death of the child, ascribed to the serpent-god's curse.

quote:
If Rahu occupies the 5th house or associates with the lord of the 5th 
unaspected by benefics, the child dies due to the curse of the serpent-god.

consequent.text: A strong Jupiter in the ascendant, 5th or 7th, unaspected by malefics: children will be born.

quote:
If strong Jupiter occupies the ascendant or the 5th or the 7th house and is 
unaspected by malefics, children will be born.
